findings.title: Granular edit CLI/core accepted malformed JSON-derived inputs
findings.description: Title newline, missing AC text, unknown table section, unknown operation kind, or non-string row values could reach patch planning from CLI casts or direct core calls.
findings.suggested_fix: Validate title as single-line text, validate AC item arrays and item text, validate table section, operation kind, values object, and string cell values before patch planning.

findings.title: Requirement ID repair accepted stale explicit reference edits
findings.description: An explicit reference edit whose source line no longer contains the requested from text was treated as planned, which could suppress ambiguity without changing the reference.
findings.suggested_fix: Validate every explicit reference edit file, line, and source token during planning and return STALE_PATCH with staleGuard on mismatch.

findings.title: Multi-file repair lacked all-touched-file freshness preflight
findings.description: Apply wrote patch plans sequentially. A stale later touched file could fail after an earlier file had already been written.
findings.suggested_fix: Before writes, compare snapshots for every touched file and fail with STALE_PATCH before the first write if any snapshot changed.
